status: Listed visual fixes applied and visually verified in Figma. Remaining implementation decisions are not yet designed or implemented.
readiness: Suitable visual reference for initial UI implementation. Not a complete responsive or behavioral specification.

fixes.issue: Same LA weekend collection displays 5, 6, and 12 places across screens

nodes.1:141: LA weekend (count omitted in compact mobile chip; list total remains 5)

fixes.issue: Mobile collection add button lies outside its 358px container
fixes.fix: Use horizontal Auto Layout; keep add button visible; put collection chips in an independently horizontally scrolling region or reduce chip labels.

fixes.issue: Mobile map markers overlap the selected callout; marker names differ from visible list places
fixes.fix: Use the same five place records as the list, separate illustrative marker positions and keep selected callout readable. Production uses geographic coordinates, not design pixel positions.

fixes.issue: Desktop map scale begins outside map viewport at x=-29
fixes.fix: Place inside map at bottom-right with 16px inset; reserve bottom-left for zoom controls.

fixes.issue: Mobile map content is 872px tall in an 884px frame
fixes.fix: Fill remaining viewport height under 48px header and anchor preview card 12px from bottom.

fixes.issue: Offline map copy implies an unimplemented capability
Desktop shows six photos while mobile shows twelve for the same place
Nearby section lists two rows but claims three
Mobile notes contain manual line breaks and an abruptly cut sentence
fixes.fix: Use container-based wrapping and intentional line-clamp on list previews; full note in details.

fixes.issue: Close/back controls have negative child offsets
fixes.fix: Give wrapper same width as hit target and reset child x to 0.
Clip screen frames while preserving overflow for intentional callouts inside map containers.

implementationDecisionsStillNeeded: Define tablet/intermediate breakpoints and scrolling behavior; 1280px desktop and 390px mobile references do not establish all responsive behavior.
Generated basemap is illustrative. Do not use its street labels or mock distances as geographic truth.
Define whether Directions opens an external map, and whether operating hours, nearby distances, transit layers and walking routes are in the MVP.
Authentication, empty-search and multi-candidate picker states remain outside the completed mobile save/loading/error design.
